description:
Mount the VeraCrypt volume '/home/ga/Volumes/project_alpha.hc' to '/home/ga/MountPoints/project'. The volume uses exFAT filesystem. You must configure the mount options so that:
1. The mounted files and directories are owned by user 'ga' (UID 1000) and group 'ga' (GID 1000).
2. Directories have '750' permissions (drwxr-x---).
3. Files have '640' permissions (-rw-r-----).
4. You verify write access by creating a file named 'access_test.txt' inside the mounted directory.

Use the password 'AlphaTeam2024'. You can use the VeraCrypt GUI (Settings > Preferences > Mount Options or the Mount Options dialog) or CLI.
